<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **68** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**8** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), getMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation; a top-level function), getOverlayRepo (literal, a string literal in DraftVerdictHost; a string literal in draftPublishVerdict))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/drivers.mdx`  _(via getMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation; a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via getMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation; a top-level function), /app/:appId/bundle (route, bridged from symbol getMetaItem — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via AUTHORING_RULES (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx`  _(via /app/:appId/bundle (route, bridged from symbol getMetaItem — its route source's handler names it))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/services-checklist.mdx`  _(via getMetaItem (symbol, a method of class ObjectStackProtocolImplementation; a top-level function))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/state-machine.mdx`  _(via /object/:name/state/:field (route, bridged from symbol getMetaItem — its route source's handler names it))_

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class), getLegalNextStates (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.getLegalNextStates, bound to GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field; the bare tail of client method meta.getLegalNextStates, bound to GET /meta/object/:name/state/:field), meta.getLegalNextStates (sdk, the route ledger binds it to GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field, selected by route anchor /object/:name/state/:field; the route ledger binds it to GET /meta/object/:name/state/:field, selected by route anchor /object/:name/state/:field))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`  _(via getLegalNextStates (sdk, the bare tail of client method meta.getLegalNextStates, bound to GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field; the bare tail of client method meta.getLegalNextStates, bound to GET /meta/object/:name/state/:field), meta.getLegalNextStates (sdk, the route ledger binds it to GET /api/v1/meta/object/:name/state/:field, selected by route anchor /object/:name/state/:field; the route ledger binds it to GET /meta/object/:name/state/:field, selected by route anchor /object/:name/state/:field))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via flowLabel (symbol, a field of interface FlowNodeSites))_
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx`  _(via /app/:appId/bundle (route, bridged from symbol getMetaItem — its route source's handler names it))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **180** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `97087294d09a65573df8d40df31d18d83c70fbde` — the merge of head `ff8171fa951eb09ed62739d9b28566dfc3b211c0` into base `7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 97087294d09a65573df8d40df31d18d83c70fbde && git checkout 97087294d09a65573df8d40df31d18d83c70fbde
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a ff8171fa951eb09ed62739d9b28566dfc3b211c0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a && git merge --no-ff ff8171fa951eb09ed62739d9b28566dfc3b211c0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7752cac7b002c6beb7b32dcc4ad2db450884151a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: 762fafa4492ab332236913f7084be9014b1cd742

Read at this head: the full diff (40 files, +1268 −32) against merge-base, the claim (6947324571) and its amendment (6947353447), the changeset, and the check runs (still in progress at 13:49Z). The head merges cleanly with main 7752cac7. `check-governed-merges` reads not governed. `Part of #34818` is the right keyword for slice 1.

The code reads right:
- `draftPublishJudgement` is one run of the same rules, with refusals and advisories side by side. `draftPublishVerdict` now only wraps it, so existing callers see no change.
- `withPublishAdvisories` is flow-only (`DRAFT_ADVISORY_TYPES`). It never touches `valid` and dedupes on path plus words. It returns the same object when nothing is added, so `serveDraft`'s `after === before` short-circuit still holds.
- `userTextLocales` comes from the resolved context at both doors, the REST draft read and `readPendingDraft`, never from the query. It selects a language only, which matches its `.describe()`.
- The UI is advisory only. `readDraftChecks` failing means no checks are shown, and it never gates Publish. The shown-mark covers only the publish's flight, and is cleared in `finally` on both surfaces.
- `flowChecksTitle` is in all 11 locales. The zh copy reads naturally.

## Must-fix

**M1. No live readings for a UI acceptance.** The body says "No browser check of the running console was taken for this slice". This card's acceptance is what a builder sees, so unit tests do not meet it. Please attach readings from the running console, at this head or the next one, in en and zh-Hans, for a flow draft that has a decision with no conditions and an approval whose approver may resolve empty:
1. After a save, the designer's Problems tab lists both findings before Publish. Clicking each one selects its step.
2. The pending-changes drawer lists the same findings under the flow's label, above Publish.
3. In zh, no finding shows `node_N`, a machine name, a rule id or an English sentence. A flow or step with no label falls back to its id, as the body says.
4. A publish from the drawer, and one from the designer, end with the title-only toast.
5. A publish the author did not review keeps the full toast: either an AI-surface publish, or the save door.

Put screenshots or DOM/network captures somewhere the next reader can open, and name them in the body.

**M2. Files outside the claim surface.** The claim and its amendment do not cover these changed files:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/flowDraftChecks.ts` (+ `.test.ts`)
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/publishChecksShown.ts`
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`
- the 11 `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (the claim named studio en/zh keys only; the key landed in the root `preview.changes` block of every locale)
- `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`
- `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`
- `packages/lint/src/flow-walk.ts`
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-host.ts`
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`

The seat should post a claim amendment naming them, or the PR should drop them. None looks wrong; this is about surface only.

**M3. The declaration differs from the claim.** The claim said `Metadata-protocol: none`, with spec at no more than patch. The PR ships `Clause-②: yes (widening …)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`, and `@objectstack/spec: minor`. The PR is the accurate one, because the new optional `GetMetaItemRequestSchema.userTextLocales` is a widening of the wire face. The seat needs to restate the claim to match, so that its fable L2 runs on the face that actually ships.

## Should-fix

- **S1.** `ResourceEditPage` marks the publish as reviewed when `draftDiagnostics.warnings` is non-empty. It does not check whether the Problems tab was shown or open. If the author published from the header without opening the tab, the toast still drops to its title line. The body states the toast is shortened only "after the checks were listed". Please either note that "listed" means present in the tab's count/badge, or check visibility. A reading for M1 item 4 that shows the badge count is enough to close this.

## Notes

- The eager key costs +26 B, but that was measured on 3bbda33b. Main has since taken #34713's eager keys, and #34851 (open) reports only 177 B of i18n-locale-en headroom. Whichever of #34850 and #34851 lands second must have a green `Build & E2E UI` (`check:eager-closure`) on its own merge ref. Re-measure if the other lands first.
- The stated bound holds by construction: advisories are folded only on the draft read, so after a publish they stay out of the Problems tab until the next save.
- The lint user-text changes (the `approval-approvers-*` sentences now name things by label, and the new `flow-decision-unconditional-branch` text in 11 locales) do not change any `message`, `where`, rule or severity. The tests in `finding-user-text.test.ts` pin this.
- CI was still running at this read. Landing needs it green at the final head.

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `762fafa4492ab332236913f7084be9014b1cd742`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts + packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-host.ts, packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts

Inputs read: card #34818 body and its five comments (triage 6947178551, premise 6947269778, claim 6947324571, ruling 6947353447, dev report 6949894941); PR #34850 body, file list (40 files) and the net diff against merge-base `3bbda33b`; the check-runs on the head, polled 2026-11-17T13:52Z. The first consumer (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/flowDraftChecks.ts`, the designer's draft re-read) and the cited code outside the diff (`userTextLocalesOf` in `packages/core`, `userTextLocalesMember` and `MetadataValidationResultSchema` in `packages/spec`, the approval and flow lint producers) were read, not reviewed. The remainder of the diff (lint, ui, i18n packs, tests, changeset prose, generated `api.json` and `protocol.mdx`) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set, `GetMetaItemRequestSchema`:** one new optional member, `userTextLocales: string[]`, at most 2. Every request accepted on `main` is still accepted; nothing is refused that was accepted. A pure widening. Right.
- **Published surface:** `authorable-surface/api.json` gains `api/GetMetaItemRequest:userTextLocales`, and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` gains the one row, word for word the schema's describe. No export added or removed. Right.
- **Served-answer change, undeclared in the schema but declared in the changeset:** a flow draft read's `_diagnostics.warnings` gains the gate's advisories. `valid` is not moved by them (`withPublishAdvisories` keeps `diagnostics.valid`, or `true` when there was no verdict), `errors[]` is untouched, and every non-flow type returns the same object as before (`DRAFT_ADVISORY_TYPES`). The entry shape is the existing `{ path, message }` of `MetadataValidationResultSchema.warnings`; no key added there. Right.
- **Verdict independence:** `draftPublishVerdict` now returns `draftPublishJudgement(...).refusals`, the same array the function returned on `main` (`told` then `issues`). The only new input to the gate run is `userTextLocales`, which `assertRuntimeAuthoringRules` already took from the save door. Refusals do not depend on it. Right.
- **Gate verdicts (check-runs on the head):** success for Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Lint · ESLint, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Type Check · source gates, Dogfood Regression Gate. **Still running at 13:52Z, so no verdict yet:** Build Core, Test Core 1-10, Test UI 1-16, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / debt ledger, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup and corpus, Build and E2E UI, Live E2E UI. This record judges the contract and the design; it does not stand in for those runs, and the dev's local figures are not adopted as their verdicts. Landing waits for them to conclude green.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: yes (widening: optional userTextLocales on GetMetaItemRequestSchema) — correct, and the same line is in the PR body and the changeset body.

- **`Metadata-protocol: added` with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor` is the right declaration.** The seat ruling 6947353447 expected `none`, but the level axis of `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` refuses `none` whenever a `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` shard moves, and `api.json` moved. The gate reads the shard, not intent. `Check Changeset` concluded success on this head with `added` and spec `minor`. The deviation over-declares, never under-declares, so nothing a consumer relies on is hidden by it.
- **"No author writes it" holds.** The member is set in exactly two places, both from the resolved execution context: `meta-item-read-routes.ts:1093` (`userTextLocalesOf(readCtx)`, draft reads only) and `domains/meta.ts:902` (`readPendingDraft`). No metadata file, stack definition or skill example can contain it; the only other writer is an in-process caller of `protocol.getMetaItem`. The `authorable-surface` inventory lists every api request key mechanically, which is why the shard moved.
- **`Skills-docs: none` holds** for the same reason. The reference page is regenerated in this diff.
- The other five released packages take `patch`. `Check Changeset` accepted that on this head.
- The #34602 / PR #34674 precedent is cited by the dev, not read here (outside the inputs). The judgment above rests on the gate's own rule text and its check-run.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** empty. Nothing to answer.
- **Deviation, `Metadata-protocol: added`:** accepted; see ②.
- **Deviation, eager pack key (+26 B gzip on `i18n-locale-en`):** accepted, and it does not belong in a lazy namespace. `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` is in the eager graph, and the new key sits beside its siblings (`preview.changes.securityBlockTitle`, `securityBlockWhere`) in the same eager packs. Moving one title into the studio namespace would pull that namespace's resident table into the eager closure, a larger cost than the key. The eager-closure budget is enforced by a check-run that had not concluded at read time; the dev's 61,648 against 62,000 is a local figure.
- **Deviation, no rule id under "learn more":** accepted. It was ruled before the work (claim 6947324571) and needs `code` on `MetadataValidationResultSchema.warnings[]`, a second spec widening the card words as optional ("可").
- **Deviation, full toast for a publish the author did not review:** accepted. The card asks for a one-line toast after the checks were listed and confirmed. Where nothing listed them (an AI surface, an item the drawer showed nothing for) the toast is the only place the findings reach the author, so keeping its body there is the conservative reading and loses nothing the card asked for.
- **Deviation, bound (the published read does not run the gate):** accepted as stated. After a publish the Problems tab lists the advisories again from the next draft.
- **Deviation, claim surface:** the added files are the first consumer and the generated artifacts of the ruled spec member. No file outside the card's two items.
- **SQL push-down:** no finding. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join. The advisories come from the one gate run the draft read already made for its refusal (`draftPublishJudgement` replaces the `draftPublishVerdict` call, it does not add a second).

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` against ruling 6947353447 and its first consumer.** The ruling allowed one optional member with the save request's shape. The diff adds exactly that shape (`z.array(z.string()).max(2).optional()`), nothing else in the file. The first consumer holds: the console's draft reads carry `Accept-Language` (the designer through the authenticated fetch, the drawer by stating it in `readDraftChecks`), the REST door resolves it into `ExecutionContext.locale`, and `userTextLocalesOf` returns at most two non-empty strings, inside the schema's bound. A read that omits the member reaches the gate with no locales and composes `en`, as the describe says.

**Implementing files, sentence by sentence against the describe.**
- "the locale the request names, then the workspace default": `userTextLocalesOf` returns `[ctx.locale, ctx.workspaceLocale]` in that order at both doors. Agrees.
- "an advisory finding that carries a user sentence becomes a `_diagnostics.warnings[]` entry in that sentence": `withPublishAdvisories` uses `userMessage` when it is a non-blank string. Agrees.
- "ABSENT ⇒ `en`" and "selects a language only: which row is read, and what the verdict is, do not depend on it": the member is spread into the gate call only, after the row is resolved; refusals are the same array as on `main`. Agrees.
- "Stated by the door that holds the request": both doors read the resolved context, neither reads a `userTextLocales` wire parameter. Agrees.
- `protocol.ts`, `protocol-host.ts`, `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`: parameter-type threading and one host method; the facade's `draftVerdictHost()` builds the same host object both bodies read. Agrees.

**Attempts to break it.**
- A finding with no item path: the two flow rules the card names both carry document paths (`flows[i].nodes[j]`, `flows[i].nodes[j].config.approvers`), which `itemRelativeIssuePath` turns into `nodes.N...`; a `where`-style locator is kept as written and still lists, without a node target. No crash path: `path` is always a string after the re-map (`f.path ?? f.where`).
- Duplicates: the fold dedupes on path and message against the warnings already present and against itself.
- An unlocalised or over-long locale list: the gate filters non-strings and walks the ladder; the doors cannot send more than two.
- Cost: one judgement per draft read, as before.
- A caller not admitted to drafts: `isDraftRead` already includes `mayReadPendingDrafts`, so the member is never stated for a read that serves the published row.

**Nits (none affects correctness or the accept-set).**
- N1 (nit) — the ruling spelled the member as `userTextLocalesMember()`; the diff writes a second inline copy of the same shape at line 445 with its own describe. The accept-set is identical, and the describe has to differ (a read, not a write). A helper taking the describe would keep the two shapes from drifting. Follow-up, not this head.
- N2 (nit) — "Read only by the `state: 'draft'` read" is narrower than the code. `serveDraft` also serves the `previewDrafts` arm (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts:973`), so a previewed flow draft now carries the folded advisories too, and the REST door states no locales for that arm, so those sentences are `en`. No console surface renders a preview read's flow warnings today. Either state the locales whenever a draft may be served, or say in the describe that the preview arm folds in `en`. The changeset's "`state: 'draft'`" wording has the same gap.
- N3 (nit) — "never read from a query string" can be misread: on REST, `ExecutionContext.locale` may itself come from `?locale=`. What is true is that the member is never a wire parameter of its own. The save twin's "never read from a wire body" does not have this problem.
- N4 (nit) — the describe does not say the fold is for flow drafts only (`DRAFT_ADVISORY_TYPES`), nor that an advisory with no user sentence is listed in its developer `message`. A reader of the published schema would expect every draft type.

N2 to N4 are describe wording on a published schema: fixing them moves the head and regenerates `protocol.mdx`, so they are left as accepted deviations for a follow-up (slice 2 or 3 of this card touches neither file; a small spec-prose card fits).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-jcwgnf`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Live readings for L1-b's REWORK (M1, S1) on #34850, taken at head `ff8171fa9`. That head is `762fafa44` plus one docs commit (`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, asked for by the docs-drift bot), so no code or schema changed. Setup:

- The script and screenshots are kept in the seat's project files under `objectstack-seat3/34818-live/`.

| Reading | zh-CN | en |
